product: GRACE and GRACE-FO · NASA GSFC RL06v2.0 mascons (land water and ice, cm equivalent water height)
processing: 12896 land and grounded-ice mascons (out of 41168), distributed onto the 2° grid by overlap area; cells with less than 50% of their area on land are omitted. 252 monthly solutions, each assigned to the month of its midpoint day; missing months are not imputed. ICE-6G_D glacial isostatic adjustment correction included in the product. Land mean drifts at most 0.0292 cm upon regridding.
citation: Loomis, B. D., Luthcke, S. B., Sabaka, T. J. (2019). Regularization and error characterization of GRACE mascons. Journal of Geodesy, 93, 1381-1398. doi:10.1007/s00190-019-01252-y. RL06v2.0 (OBP-ICE6GD) solution from NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, Geodesy and Geophysics Laboratory.
